findings.problem: When the pinned steps strip first appears, the whole board (title, question line, corner sketch, axes) jumps down by about one strip height. This happens between the empty-axes frame and the first pin.
findings.fix: Reserve the pinned strip's height from the first beat so that the steps fade in without pushing the board down.

findings.problem: The voice says that as X goes left the curve gets closer to the X axis, but nothing on the sketch is lit. The student is not pointed at the tail that does the approaching.
findings.fix: Light the left-hand tail of the curve on the axes (or the x-axis itself) on the words "as X goes left".
